text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-api" — p99 latency crossed 1200ms in eu-west, count=480 in last 5m. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/latency-p99
pagerduty-bot: Pager: inference-api.p99 — page triggered -> oncall@sre (urgency: high). Escalation in 10m if unacked.
sam: Acked. I'm on it. pulling dashboards now :eyes:
maya: Seeing a big spike in kv-cache evictions around 12:14UTC, heatmap shows hotkey in /embed route.
liam: Any recent rollout? I don't see new model swaps but autoscaler shows many preemptions. Might be a sidecar OOM cascade.
sam: No rollout. Logs: 
```
2026-03-18T12:13:09Z inference-api[sidecar]: OOMKill on sidecar-abc123, evicting kv shards
2026-03-18T12:13:11Z inference-api[pod/worker-7]: p99=1350ms p95=420ms
```
dave: Can we divert traffic to the dedicated pool in eu-west-2 while we triage? That will buy time.
sam: Attempting runbook step: reroute traffic to fallback pool -> `redwood route shift --service inference-api --from eu-west --to eu-west-dedicated --weight 70`
sam: ran command, API returned 202. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: Traffic routing job started (id: tr-179881). 70% shifted, remaining 30% ramping down.
maya: After shift p99 dropped to ~600ms on the main cluster but eu-west still has tail at ~900ms. Hotkey persists.
liam: If kv hotkey is the issue we should hot-shard and increase sidecar mem; trying `kubectl patch sts sidecar --patch 'spec: replicas: +2'`? (running low risk)
sam: Spinning two extra sidecar replicas in eu-west. `kubectl scale deployment sidecar --replicas=5 -n inference`
olivia: Noting customer impact: a subset of streaming user sessions saw slow responses — support ticket queue starting to fill. I'm prepping a brief to customer success.
dave: Also enabling prefix caching on the fallback pool for embed endpoints to reduce kv pressure.
sam: p99 now ~280ms cluster-wide, eu-west tail at ~340ms after scale + reroute. Looks stable. :thumbsup:
olivia: Notifying support to update affected customers: "We experienced a temporary increase in inference latency; mitigation applied; monitoring for stability."
maya: Adding postmortem checklist entries: investigate root cause of sidecar OOMs, examine autoscaler preemption pattern, identify hotkey source, add KV sharding rules.
sam: Pulling metrics for 30m window and saving to incident log: https://dashboards.redwood/incidents/1798812345
pagerduty-bot: Page acknowledged by sam. Autocalculate: escalation suppressed.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated, p99 back under 350ms for 10 consecutive minutes. Recommend no further escalation.
sam: I'll keep watch for 15m then close the page. Thanks all.
dave: Great job — adding temporary throttle on the hotkey as precaution.
olivia: Filing a customer-impact blurb and tagging CS.
sam: Closing page now, marking incident as mitigated. Will follow up with postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
